title: Hostinger Production R6 registration context repair

phases.objective: Restore GitHub workflow registration by moving runner-scoped temporary-directory initialization out of job-level env and into a runner step.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: same-repository Draft pull_request opened event changing only the governed R6 trigger JSON
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub registers the R6 workflow, initializes EVIDENCE_DIR from RUNNER_TEMP after runner allocation, and preserves the existing read-only evidence contract.
steps: Remove runner.temp from jobs.collect-release-evidence.env where the runner context is unavailable during workflow registration.
Initialize EVIDENCE_DIR through GITHUB_ENV in a shell step after checkout.
Run the existing R6 static contract with regression assertions for the registration-safe context.
assertions: No job-level EVIDENCE_DIR expression references runner.temp.
The runner-scoped directory is exported from RUNNER_TEMP through GITHUB_ENV.
All Hostinger provider and repository no-mutation boundaries remain unchanged.
